title: Silicone Cable Holder Clips
summary: Adhesive silicone clips that hold charging cables on a desk or nightstand. No magnets.
bodyHtml:
Adhesive silicone clips that hold charging cables on a desk or nightstand. No magnets.

Materials: Silicone with adhesive pad

In the box: 8 clips

Care: Wipe clean. Adhesive holds best on a dry, smooth surface. Removing a clip may leave residue.

Processing: 1–2 business days. Tracked international shipping. A light item, suitable for a first test order.

title: Drawer Organizer
summary: Open bins for sorting a shallow drawer. Use in a desk, vanity, or kitchen drawer.
bodyHtml:
Open bins for sorting a shallow drawer. Use in a desk, vanity, or kitchen drawer.

Materials: PP

In the box: organizer pieces in mixed sizes

Care: Wipe clean.

This is a drawer organizer, not a cosmetic kit. Processing: 1–2 business days. Tracked international shipping.

title: Bamboo Drawer Divider
summary: Adjustable bamboo dividers that expand to split a drawer into sections.
bodyHtml:
Adjustable bamboo dividers that expand to split a drawer into sections.

Processing: 1–2 business days. Tracked international shipping.

title: Kitchen Sink Caddy
summary: A caddy that holds a sponge and brush beside the sink. Drain holes let water run off. No soap is included.
bodyHtml:
A caddy that holds a sponge and brush beside the sink. Drain holes let water run off. No soap or liquid is included.
